name: addressless-sensor
description:
REGRESSION LOCK on the networkInterfaces=[None] abort. A sensor that has checked in with no int_ip, no ext_ip and no mac_addr -- routine for a freshly enrolled or offline agent -- makes network_interface() return None, and build_assets used to pass networkInterfaces=[None] to ImportAsset regardless. The runtime rejects that with "network_interfaces must be an iterable of NetworkInterface objects" and the WHOLE run died: the healthy sensor in the same page was lost too, and zero assets were exported.

The fix builds the list only when network_interface returns a value, so the addressless sensor imports with no interface and correlates on its hostname. Both sensors must survive.

Skips namespaced_ids: the foreign id is the bare LimaCharlie sid with no organization scope, the same defect the happy scenario records.
